_about: Synthetic K4 fixture (plans/2026-11-18-car-knowledge/K1-design.md 5b, 7): the review screen with the car map on. Generated photos, made-up make and model, the K1 worked examples' generic assemblies only (front bumper, boot lid, a left front fender), never a case. Fields at their defaults are left out, as the server sends them. The strip-down block holds 6, 2 via a second hop; the grille has a linked check 'no'; the arch liner has no assembly (a catalogue neighbour) and keeps the listed part's group.

data.description: Made-up front and rear hit for the K4 review screen fixture.

damage_summary.reason: Bumper cover cracked and pushed in across the middle
Lid buckled at its lower edge

second_look.note: The second look is switched off.

items.name: Head lamp RH
items.reason: Lens cracked at the outer corner

evidence.reason: Lens cracked at the outer corner

items.name: Front bumper reinforcement
items.reason: Sits behind the cover; a pushed-in cover can bend it.

signs_yes.ask: Is the bumper cover pushed inward, not just scratched?

items.name: Fog lamp LH
items.reason: Sits in the bumper's corner; a hit there often cracks it.

items.name: Front number plate
items.reason: Mounted on the bumper's face; a centre hit bends it.

items.name: Front grille
items.reason: Clips into the bumper's top edge; a push moves it out of line.

link_check.reason: Grille looks straight and its clips in place

items.name: Tail gate lock
items.reason: Latches the lid; a hard hit to the lid can jam it.

signs_yes.ask: Is the boot lid open, tied shut, or not closed flush?

items.name: Tail gate hinge
items.reason: Carries the lid; a hit that shifts the lid bends it.

items.name: Reverse camera
items.reason: Sits in the lid's garnish above the plate.

items.name: Front wheel arch moulding LH
items.reason: Clipped to the fender's arch edge.

items.name: Front wheel arch liner LH
items.reason: Shares a parts diagram with the Left Front Fender; check it with that part.

items.name: Condenser
items.reason: Sits behind the bumper and grille; a deep centre hit reaches it.

items.name: Engine under cover
items.reason: Bolted under the bumper; a low hit tears its mounts.

items.name: Radiator
items.reason: Behind the condenser; a hit deep enough to reach the condenser can reach it.

items.name: Tail gate inner trim
items.reason: Clipped inside the lid; a creased lid cracks its clips.

items.name: Rear end panel
items.reason: Under the lid's lower edge; a hard push carries into it.

items.name: Rear floor panel
items.reason: Behind the rear end panel; it buckles when that panel is pushed in.
